description: Provides utility methods for server communication in an Android sample sync application, including authentication, data synchronization, and avatar downloading.

classes.name: NetworkUtilities
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to handle network operations like authentication, data sync, and avatar download in an Android environment.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Creates and configures an HttpClient with timeout settings.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Handles server authentication by posting username and password, returning an auth token.

methods.name: syncContacts
methods.description: Performs synchronization of contacts with the server, sending local changes and returning updated contacts.

methods.name: downloadAvatar
methods.description: Downloads avatar images from a given URL and converts them into JPEG byte arrays.
